per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The UI must detect scheduling conflicts and warn the user before saving; for clear conflicts the system must block the action unless a user with higher privileges explicitly overrides.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The system shall help the user avoid making mistakes while scheduling classes and clinicals for the nursing students.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must validate prerequisite and eligibility rules and prevent enrollment unless an authorized override is provided and documented.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The system shall have basic data integrity checking to reduce the possibility of incorrect or invalid data being introduced.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must provide role-based access control so that Program Admins have broad access, instructors see their class rosters and evaluations, site coordinators see only students assigned to their site (limited contact info), and support staff can generate reports without changing enrollments.

Terminology and labels in the UI must use language familiar to nursing staff (e.g., 'student' or 'learner' rather than 'enrollment participant', 'placements' vs 'assignments') and avoid jargon or invented words.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The verbiage used within the system shall be consistent with Standard English and the terminology of the national Nursing Community.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Core fields must use controlled vocabularies (dropdowns/picklists) for course types, clinical roles, and site names to enforce consistent data for reporting; free text is allowed only for notes.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The verbiage used within the system shall be consistent with Standard English and the terminology of the national Nursing Community.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Small, routine interactions (e.g., adding a student to a class) must respond within up to approximately 5 seconds; heavy operations (e.g., generating a full schedule for a term) must complete within approximately 30 seconds and no more than 60 seconds.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The response time of general student management tasks shall take no longer than 5 seconds and the response time of schedule generation shall take no longer than 30 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must handle peak concurrency of about ten concurrent users from the nursing office during busy windows without degraded performance.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'system shall be able to handle all of the user requests/usage during business hours.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must be available during business hours (approx. 08:00–18:00 weekdays), with higher reliability during critical scheduling windows; aim for approximately 95% overall availability but higher guarantees for critical windows.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The system shall achieve 95% up time.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must integrate with the CampusConnect system for student records and single sign-on and must not act as the master for enrollments or IDs.

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Roster and enrollment data must be propagated in real-time or near-real-time (not just nightly batch) so changes in CampusConnect appear promptly in the app.

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: When importing CSV rosters, the system must validate formatting and rows, highlight or reject problematic rows, and not silently import invalid data.

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must perform basic data validation (e.g., reject impossible dates, enforce valid course codes, prevent duplicate records via smart matching).
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The system shall have basic data integrity checking to reduce the possibility of incorrect or invalid data being introduced.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Program Admins should be empowered to correct most day-to-day data errors within the app, while structural/systemic fixes should be handled by IT.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The system shall be easy to use by the Program Administrators/Nursing Staff Members.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must comply with the university's information policy and restrict access to students' personal and health-related data so sensitive fields are not visible to unauthorized roles.

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Instructors should see identifiers and evaluations for their students; site coordinators should see only name, contact, and student status needed to run the clinical day, not full student records.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The system shall be easy to use by the Program Administrators/Nursing Staff Members.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The platform should be designed for a multi-year lifespan (target ~5 years) and support configurable, versioned curriculum maps to accommodate periodic curriculum changes without code changes.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The system shall be expected to manage the nursing program curriculum and class/clinical scheduling for a minimum of 5 years.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must support notifications via university-preferred channels (email, optional SMS, and in-app) and allow users to configure preferences including immediacy (immediate for critical changes, daily digest for minor edits).

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Ad-hoc reports must be fast; term-wide exports and accreditation exports can take longer but must finish in a reasonable time and be accurate, supporting CSV and Excel formats and including historical curriculum and student progression.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The response time of general student management tasks shall take no longer than 5 seconds and the response time of schedule generation shall take no longer than 30 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The UI should include inline help and example text in forms to reduce support calls and improve learnability so common tasks can be completed without a manual or training.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The system shall be easy to use by the Program Administrators/Nursing Staff Members.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must prevent and detect duplicate course codes and inconsistent entries; reporting should rely on consistent authoritative identifiers to avoid missing records in batch reports.
